instruction: Find the row with the maximum "Revenue" value and add a comment "Maximum Revenue" to that cell in the Revenue column

metadata.explanation: Evaluator dynamically finds the row with maximum Revenue value by parsing all Revenue column data. The metric verifies that a comment with text 'Maximum Revenue' exists on the row containing the maximum Revenue value (expected to be row 13 with value 59875). The getter extracts both comment positions and Revenue column data to enable semantic verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks both requirements - (1) comment text is 'Maximum Revenue' and (2) comment is placed on the row with actual maximum Revenue value

Correct semantic verification: Getter dynamically finds the row with maximum Revenue by scanning all Revenue column values, then metric verifies the comment is on that dynamically-found row (not hardcoded)
Correct data flow: Getter extracts all Revenue values, computes max_revenue_row, and extracts all cells with comments. Metric checks that a comment with expected text exists on the max_revenue_row

Edge case handling: Getter handles non-numeric Revenue values gracefully (skips them), searches for Revenue column in header (defaults to column B if not found), and returns None for max_revenue_row if no valid data found (metric correctly returns 0.0 in this case)
Postconfig is appropriate: Saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure comments are persisted before verification
